observed_failures.note: Caller supplied 0.93 GiB instead of the decimal 1 GB default; later attempts use the unchanged intended 1 GB default.

diagnosis: HydroLAKES finished writing but restoring the first native-ID bucket loaded unusually large geometries together. LakeATLAS exceeded the cap during wide-table bucket staging. The follow-up removes complete geometry restore buckets, compares attributes one column at a time, checks every WKB by native-ID SHA-256/length/null state, and reduces staging batch/buffer sizes. Full runs must establish the memory bound; no gate is waived.

changes.attribute_comparison: Exact complete column equality after native-ID restoration
changes.wkb_comparison: Complete per-native-ID SHA-256, byte length and null state; every byte independently hashed in both files

validator_constraint.note: This installed rule has a row-count ceiling, not a compressed/uncompressed byte-size ceiling. Actual full Portolan validation remains mandatory.

cleanup: User approved 103 inventoried temporary files and subsequent failed-run staging cleanup for these HydroLAKES/LakeATLAS builds after preserving checksums and failure reports. The 103-file cleanup is complete; each subsequent cleanup gets its own inventory and receipt. Validated originals, completed datasets, scripts and reports are preserved.
